name: Field Label Wrapper
description: The label half of the field wrapper pattern: entryLabelOuterDiv > entryLabelDiv > lbl. Always paired with atom.field-value-wrapper as siblings inside the same parent. This exact pair is the most repeated structure in the codebase (~1700 occurrences) — do not build a different field-labeling structure.
note: In real files, entryLabelOuterDiv is the PARENT of both entryLabelDiv and entryValueDiv (see molecules/field-text.json for the complete composed wrapper). This atom file shows the label half only, in isolation, for documentation; do not use it standalone without the value half.
